$comment: Test fixture exercising all fields of the canada extension, spanning multiple provinces to populate all $defs

quebecPatrimony.equalisation: Equal division of family patrimony between surviving spouse and estate
quebecPatrimony.notes: Quebec family patrimony includes family residences, furnishings, motor vehicles, and registered retirement savings. Applies notwithstanding the matrimonial regime chosen.

ontarioEqualization.notes: Surviving spouse elected to receive equalization payment under the Family Law Act rather than the entitlement under the will. Net family property calculated as of valuation date.

bcWesaVariation.courtReference: Vancouver Registry No. P-2025-04832, In the Matter of the Estate of Margaret Chen
bcWesaVariation.notes: Wills, Estates and Succession Act s.60 variation order granted to adult child who was not adequately provided for. Court varied the will to provide a lump sum of $150,000.

albertaDower.notes: Surviving spouse has a life estate in the homestead under the Dower Act. Consent to disposition was not given prior to death.

indigenousLandDetails.reserveName: Six Nations of the Grand River
indigenousLandDetails.successionRestrictions: Transfer restricted to band members under Indian Act s.49
indigenousLandDetails.notes: Certificate of Possession land on Six Nations reserve. Succession must be approved by the Minister and the transferee must be a band member.
Reserve land allocated by Mohawk Council of Kahnawake. Not subject to provincial succession law.
